properties.notes: Request for a screening opinion in respect of proposed residential redevelopment for up to 300 homes, relocation of CMS garage and associated highway works that include new arm off Blackwell Street roundabout from St Marys ring road to provide direct access to Churchfields and creation of one way traffic routes along Horse Fair and Blackwell Street at Churchfields, Kidderminster. Application due January 2018. Outline Planning Application for the redevelopment of the site to create approximately 95 residential dwellings, including conversion of one existing building to create 16 flats, along with approximately 669sqm of (B1) office space. NB application due January 2018 will supercede this application
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
